name: Coffee Talk
short_description: Run a late-night café on a rainy street, brew drinks for regulars and listen to their stories.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Run a late-night café on a rainy street, brew drinks for regulars and listen to their stories.

identity.core_loop: A customer sits, talks, orders; mix three ingredients, serve, listen to how it lands; the night moves on.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Slow, warm and quiet; the drink you make is the only button that matters.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Almost everything is the counter and the faces: who sits down, what they say, how they react to the cup. The recipe book is summoned; the rain and the clock on the night set the mood.

identity.art_direction: Chunky pixel art in one fixed café view, warm lamps against a cold rainy window.

rendering.signature: Chunky pixel people in one fixed café view; warm lamp colours inside and cold blue rain outside are painted into the palette, not lit.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Mood can come from two colour temperatures in one frame: warm inside, cold outside. No lighting system needed.

identity.audio_mood: Lo-fi jazz beats, rain on glass, the hiss of the espresso machine.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: A café is a listening game: one small craft verb (make the drink) carried by faces and talk. The window, the rain and the music do the mood with no UI.
